questions.question: Which specific constitutional precedent was established by the 'Good Parliament' of 1376?
options: The first formal use of impeachment against royal ministers
The mandatory use of English in all parliamentary records
The abolition of the feudal system of land tenure
The declaration of the King's supremacy over the Pope

questions.question: The 1349 'Ordinance of Labourers' was a direct precursor to the 1351 Statute. What was its primary economic objective?
options: To grant freedom to all remaining serfs
To fix wages at pre-plague levels and mandate work for the able-bodied
To introduce a national wealth tax to fund the war in France
To encourage the migration of laborers to the northern counties

questions.question: In the context of the Hundred Years' War, the Treaty of Brétigny (1360) is significant for which reason?
options: It marked the total surrender of the French crown to Edward III
It established a temporary peace where Edward III renounced his claim to the French throne in exchange for sovereign lands
It was the first treaty written entirely in Middle English
It led to the immediate execution of John II of France

options: That the King should be the head of the Church
That the state has the right to divest a corrupt Church of its property
That the Latin Vulgate is the only valid scriptural source
That the Pope is the only legitimate authority in civil law

questions.question: The 1381 Peasants' Revolt was ideologically fueled by the preaching of John Ball. Which of the following best represents his famous radical egalitarian couplet?
options: When Adam delved and Eve span, Who was then the gentleman?
The King is rich, the poor are thin, Let the revolution now begin.
God made the earth for one and all, To rise together or together fall.
Gold is heavy, bread is light, We shall claim our natural right.

options: His rejection of the doctrine of Transubstantiation
His belief in the baptism of infants

questions.question: What was the primary motive behind the 1380 Poll Tax, which served as the 'spark' for the 1381 uprising?
options: To pay for the king's coronation
To fund the increasingly expensive and unsuccessful war in France
To build a new palace for John of Gaunt
To provide relief for plague victims
